newsitem.title: USA: U.S. factory orders down again in December.
newsitem.headline: U.S. factory orders down again in December.

text.p: New orders received by U.S. factories dropped for a second consecutive month in December, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday, largely because of weaker demand for electronic equipment.

Orders were down 1.3 percent to a seasonally adjusted $315.93 billion following a revised 0.5 percent decrease in November orders. The December drop was sharper than the 0.8 percent decline forecast by Wall Street economists and pointed to a moderating pace of manufacturing activity at year-end.
